dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: I rarely encounter opportunities to rest mid-journey. During battle, slowing down is even more out of the question.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: However, given that this is not a solo operation, I will go along with what you think is best.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: In any case, this is an acceptable place for a brief period of respite.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: People often believe me to be highly focused on securing victories — I am a Champion Duelist, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: The truth, however, is just the opposite. It is the spirit of the challenger that I value above all else. If someone is willing to face me head-on, they have my respect, no matter who secures the title of victor in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Strength is something that can be gained through experience. Courage, however, comes from within.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: I think I'll read a little before the next battle begins.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Please refrain from recommending something like a newspaper. I recognize that short-form articles may be a fitting choice considering the limited amount of time at our disposal...

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: But they're simply not to my taste.
